messages:
Asha Patel: Heads up — SigmaCloud's PO is being rejected by the marketplace EDI pipeline. ACK shows `TaxCode: UNK` and vendor EIN doesn't match our ledger. Sigma legal also pushed a net-60 SOW redline this morning. Can deal-desk + finance triage? :eyes:

Tom Greene: On it. Can you paste the EDI fragment (or screenshot) so I can repro locally?

Asha Patel: Here — small snippet from the vendor EDI: ```<Invoice><VendorEIN>12-3456789</VendorEIN><TaxCode>UNK</TaxCode></Invoice>``` Sigma's portal lists EIN as `123456789` (no dash). Procurement insists exact match to their SAP to pay.

Leah Wong: Finance — net-60 is unusual for this tier but not impossible. Main blocker is the EIN formatting mismatch. If Sigma can provide an affidavit tying the two numbers to the same legal entity we can accept invoices, but AP will flag until we get docs.

Rajiv Menon: CS chiming in — procurement buyer said they will reject invoices that don't match PO EIN. Customer won't sign off on manual payment exceptions. They're already threatening to delay go-live.

Tom Greene: I'll open an ops ticket with marketplace-ops and ask them to re-run EDI validation with relaxed EIN parsing as a temporary workaround. Tagging @marketplace-bot to trigger a re-check.

marketplace-bot: EDI validation job queued for re-run by Tom Greene (job 98765). Current error: `vendor_ein_mismatch` + `unknown_tax_code`. Suggested action: request vendor affidavit OR reissue PO with normalized EIN.

Asha Patel: Thanks. Two asks: (1) Leah — can Finance approve a provisional acceptance path if legal signs a one-off waiver? (2) Tom — if ops can do temporary acceptance, we'll request Sigma to upload affidavit and reissue corrected PO within 72h.

Leah Wong: I'll run this by AP lead. If legal signs, we can do provisional acceptance but will require holdback clause in billing until affidavit is uploaded. I'll update within the hour. :pray:

Tom Greene: Ops confirmed they can do a manual accept for one billing cycle but need a formal ticket with the affidavit upload checklist. I'll create it and ping everyone.

Asha Patel: Great — looping in Sigma legal to expedite affidavit + PO reissue. Will update thread once we have docs. Thanks all.
